# Challenge 3: unlock premium without the key

Make the app believe `premium` is true. The Upgrade to Premium button is
forbidden.

**Hints**:

<details>
<summary>Hint 1</summary>

`GameState.premium` is a public static boolean.
</details>

<details>
<summary>Hint 2</summary>

Static fields are read and written with `.value`.
</details>

See [Unlocking premium](../android_journey/unlocking_premium.qmd) for the
field and the status line.
